workflows.name: ai-rag-implementation
workflows.title: AI/RAG Implementation
workflows.description: Build a retrieval-augmented AI feature: ingest the knowledge base, retrieve the right context, ground the model's answers, and evaluate the result.

workflows.name: architecture-review
workflows.title: Architecture Review
workflows.description: Review an existing system's architecture for coherence, scalability, and maintainability, and produce prioritized recommendations.

workflows.name: article-publishing
workflows.title: Article Publishing
workflows.description: Take an article from brief to published page: research, writing, optimization, images, review, and publish.

workflows.name: authentication-implementation
workflows.title: Authentication Implementation
workflows.description: Add sign-in to an application: choose the method, implement sessions, add MFA or passkeys where they fit, and verify the result.

workflows.name: code-audit
workflows.title: Code Audit
workflows.description: Audit a codebase for correctness, security, maintainability, and dependency health, and produce a prioritized findings report.

workflows.name: database-migration
workflows.title: Database Migration
workflows.description: Change a database schema safely: design the migration, prove it on a copy, apply it with a rollback plan, and verify the result.

workflows.name: feature-development
workflows.title: Feature Development
workflows.description: Take a feature from request to merged, tested code.

workflows.name: image-generation
workflows.title: Image Generation
workflows.description: Create images for content and sharing: featured images, OG images, and thumbnails — optimized and accessible.

workflows.name: new-project
workflows.title: New Project
workflows.description: Start a project from scratch: design the architecture, scaffold the repository, and reach a deployable first version.

workflows.name: performance-audit
workflows.title: Performance Audit
workflows.description: Measure a site's performance, find the biggest bottlenecks, fix them, and verify the improvement with numbers.

workflows.name: production-deployment
workflows.title: Production Deployment
workflows.description: Deploy an application to production infrastructure: provision the target, roll out the release, verify health, and be ready to roll back. This workflow covers the deployment mechanics; the release event itself (versioning, changelog, go/no-go) follows `workflows/production-release.md`.

workflows.name: production-release
workflows.title: Production Release
workflows.description: Ship a release safely: verify, document, deploy, and watch it in production.

workflows.name: sdk-development
workflows.title: SDK Development
workflows.description: Build a client SDK for an API: design the surface, generate or write the client, document it, version it, and publish it.

workflows.name: secure-api-development
workflows.title: Secure API Development
workflows.description: Build an API that is correct and secure from the first endpoint: contract, authentication, validation, and tests — not security bolted on afterwards.

workflows.name: security-review
workflows.title: Security Review
workflows.description: Review a system for security weaknesses — threat model, auth, secrets, and vulnerability patterns — and produce prioritized findings with fixes. This workflow is security-only and deeper than the security step in `workflows/code-audit.md`; use the code audit for general reviews.

workflows.name: seo-audit
workflows.title: SEO Audit
workflows.description: Audit a site's search visibility end to end: crawling, indexing, on-page, structured data, performance, and measurement.
